say:0:1013602001:0.text: Look! Shovels, spades, slates, and materials for golems—
say:0:1013602001:0.source_cn: 呜哇！主人，看到了吗？这里有铁锹、铲子、石板和魔偶材料——
say:0:1013602001:0.male: Look! Shovels, spades, slates, and materials for golems—
say:0:1013602001:0.female: Look! Shovels, spades, slates, and materials for golems—

say:1:1013602002:0.text: It's like we're back at the Evergreen Conservatory's camp!
say:1:1013602002:0.source_cn: 简直有点像冬青学会的地盘！

say:2:1013602003:0.text: But the people here don't seem like scholars at all...
say:2:1013602003:0.source_cn: 但这里活动的家伙们，一点都不像学者……
